## Reading the table

The selected model is chosen using the earlier validation period. The performance
logistic model is shown alongside it to make individual rankings inspectable;
it is an exploratory alternative, not the validation winner. Ties in the selected
model do not establish a ranking. Country groups use dated auction affiliation.

Career statistics mean **observed IPL career before the forecast date**. Batting
average is runs per dismissal; strike rate is runs per 100 balls faced. A missing
average means no recorded dismissals. Players without batting records can be
bowlers; there is no role filter or age predictor in this model yet.

The outcome is at least one recorded senior Test, ODI or T20I appearance, rather
than a squad announcement. The sample is IPL participants with no known prior
international appearance. Archive omissions can affect both eligibility and
outcomes. See the [protocol](docs/protocol.md) and [backtests](out/report.md).
